privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy describes how Transcendence ("we", "us", or "our") collects, uses, and protects your personal information when you use our multiplayer Pong game platform.
privacy.s1Body: We collect information you provide directly when creating an account, including your username, email address, and optional display alias. If you choose to sign in with Google OAuth, we receive your name and email from Google. We also collect gameplay statistics such as wins and losses, and profile pictures you choose to upload.
privacy.s2Body: We use your information to operate and maintain the platform, authenticate your identity, display your profile and statistics to other players, enable real-time multiplayer gameplay, and improve the application. We do not sell your personal data to third parties.
privacy.s3Body: Your data is stored securely on our servers. Passwords are hashed and never stored in plain text. Profile images are stored in isolated object storage. We implement industry-standard security measures including two-factor authentication (2FA) support to protect your account.
privacy.s4Body: We use cookies solely for session management and language preference storage. No tracking or advertising cookies are used. You can disable cookies in your browser settings, but doing so may affect the functionality of the platform.
privacy.s5Body: We integrate Google OAuth for optional sign-in. When you use this feature, Google's privacy policy also applies. We do not share your data with any other third parties.
privacy.s6Body: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data at any time. You can update your profile information in the Settings page. To request complete account deletion, please contact the platform administrators.
privacy.s7Body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be reflected by updating the date at the top of this page. Continued use of the platform after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
privacy.s8Body: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, please open an issue on our project repository.
